title: Mouse eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#a8b8c8'/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#c8d8e8'/>
  <!-- Mouse head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='42' r='16' fill='#b0c0d0'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='11' fill='#d0e0f0'/>
  <!-- Left ear -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='9' fill='#b0c0d0'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='5' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <!-- Right ear -->
  <circle cx='61' cy='30' r='9' fill='#b0c0d0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='30' r='5' fill='#f0a0b0'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='3' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='40' r='3' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='39' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='39' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='48' r='3' fill='#f07090'/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='45' x2='42' y2='47' stroke='#8898a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='49' x2='42' y2='49' stroke='#8898a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='47' x2='66' y2='45' stroke='#8898a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='49' x2='66' y2='49' stroke='#8898a8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Cookie being held -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='10' fill='#d4a050'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#b88030' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Cookie chips -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#8a5a20'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#8a5a20'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='58' r='1.5' fill='#8a5a20'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='57' r='1.2' fill='#8a5a20'/>
  <!-- Little paws holding cookie -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='60' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M 28 68 Q 15 66 12 78 Q 10 88 20 88' fill='none' stroke='#f0a0b0' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#c0d0e0'/>
  <!-- Crumbs floating -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#e8c060'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='55' r='1' fill='#e8c060'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='1.2' fill='#e8c060'/>
</svg>
